hello.speaker: elsbeth
hello.text: Have you seen a boy? Sandy hair, a laugh like a goose. My Edrin. He went up to the Barrow three nights ago.

choices.text: I am going to the Barrow. I will look for him.
You are not telling me everything.
I am sorry. I have not.

confess.speaker: elsbeth
confess.text: He went for me. I told him his father's ring was buried with the old dead up there. It was a story. It was only ever a story.

nothing.speaker: elsbeth
nothing.text: There is nothing to tell. He is a good boy. He is only late.

promise.speaker: elsbeth
promise.text: Bring him home. Please. I will be here. I am always here.

waiting.speaker: elsbeth
waiting.text: Is there word? No. No, of course. I will wait.

thanks.speaker: elsbeth
thanks.text: He is home. He is HOME, and eating everything in the house. Take this. It was his father's, and it kept him safe at sea for thirty years.

after.speaker: elsbeth
after.text: Saints keep you, wherever you walk.
